conclusion: The operator's prior hypothesis (that the RS opportunity router's 96.3% ON rate on EvoEmo reflects under-firing ESConv-calibrated exclusion regexes) was tested against real independent reviewer judgment and DISCONFIRMED. All 18 real EvoEmo states -- 14 from the router's dominant 'substantive-only' feature bucket (which alone covers 78.5% of the full 4689-state corpus) plus 4 from other feature-combination buckets -- were independently judged to genuinely present an RS opportunity, applying the router's own eligible_families exclusion construct verbatim (not the operator's intuition). The reviewer showed real differentiated engagement: 3 distinct applicable strategy families assigned across the sample, content-specific rationale per item, and explicit reasoning rejecting the gratitude-only exclusion for a borderline case rather than reflexive agreement. The most defensible conclusion is that EvoEmo's dialogue (GPT-4o-generated, consistently substantive by construction) is simply a domain where a near-universal RS opportunity rate is a genuine, construct-faithful property -- not a bug requiring a threshold or feature fix.
